name: no-unhandled-result
description: Disallow accessing .value on a Result without checking .ok first. DISABLED 2026-11-12: the pattern cannot discriminate a Result from any other { ok, value } shape. `\w+\.value` matched 753 sites and the narrowed `\w*[Rr]esult\.value` still matches 915 (Result-named locals, wire envelopes, zod results). A rule that flags every candidate teaches authors to ignore it; re-enable with a Result-branded accessor or an AST rule.
fixHint: Check result.ok before accessing result.value, or use fold/unwrapOr/map combinators from the Result type
